def: to stand apart, i.e. (reflexively) to remove, intervene
kjv: go further, be parted, after the space of

occurrences.text: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this fellow also was with him: for he is a Galilean.
And it came to pass, while he blessed them, he was parted from them, and carried up into heaven.
And sounded, and found it twenty fathoms: and when they had gone a little further, they sounded again, and found it fifteen fathoms.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
